We match you with a vetted local accountant who knows your part of the region — from CBD professionals to Maitland trades and Hunter Valley primary producers.

mainEntity.name: How do I find a registered accountant in Newcastle–Maitland through your service?

acceptedAnswer.text: Enter your Newcastle or Maitland postcode and what you need help with in our 60-second questionnaire. We match you with a vetted local accountant whose services fit your situation — not just any firm on a map. You can verify any agent on the public TPB register at tpb.gov.au.

mainEntity.name: Are all the Newcastle–Maitland accountants in your network registered tax agents?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Every accounting firm in our Newcastle–Maitland network is thoroughly vetted. They are fully qualified Registered Tax Agents, CPAs, or Chartered Accountants — all registered with the Tax Practitioners Board (TPB) and operating in compliance with NSW and Australian Tax Office (ATO) standards.

mainEntity.name: Can a Newcastle–Maitland accountant help with both my personal tax return and my small business?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. Many Hunter region firms handle both individual returns and business accounting. Whether you need a personal tax return in Hamilton, company tax structuring in the Newcastle CBD, or SMSF advice in Maitland, we match you with a specialist suited to your exact requirements across Newcastle and the Hunter.

mainEntity.name: What if I need an accountant who understands the Hunter property market and NSW tax rules?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Newcastle–Maitland property landscape and NSW state taxes — stamp duty, land tax with a general threshold of $1,075,000, and payroll tax above $1.2 million in annual wages at 5.45% — interact with federal tax in complex ways. We match you with a Hunter accountant who understands NSW's rules and how they apply to investment property, negative gearing changes and capital gains across the Newcastle and Maitland market.

mainEntity.name: How quickly will a Newcastle–Maitland accountant contact me after I complete the questionnaire?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most matches are completed within 60 seconds of finishing the questionnaire. Your matched firm will typically reach out within 2 hours, or you can call for immediate assistance to discuss your needs and schedule a consultation at their Newcastle or Maitland office or by phone.

mainEntity.name: Is the Newcastle–Maitland matching service really free with no obligation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our matching service is 100% free with zero obligation. You can speak with your matched accountant, review their initial offer, and decide if you want to proceed — no pressure, no hidden fees. We are engaged by the accounting firms, not by you.

mainEntity.name: Can I get a Newcastle–Maitland accountant who offers phone or video consultations instead of an office visit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Many firms in our Hunter network offer fully digital cloud services via Xero, MYOB, and phone or Zoom consultations. You can specify whether you prefer in-person meetings in the Newcastle CBD or online service during your questionnaire — whichever suits your schedule.

mainEntity.name: Do you cover all of Newcastle and Maitland or just the city centres?

acceptedAnswer.text: We cover all of Newcastle and Maitland — from the Newcastle CBD and Hamilton to Charlestown, Wallsend, Maitland, Rutherford and Mayfield. Enter your postcode in the questionnaire and we will match you with a vetted accountant whose services fit your area, whether you are in the city centre or the outer Hunter suburbs.
